overview: Pick the services your app should talk to and we connect them properly. That can be payments, in-app subscriptions, analytics, push messages, an email tool or your own backend API. We keep keys safely outside the app code, handle failures with clear messages, test with sandbox accounts and write short notes so the next developer knows how each connection works.

A full set of connections including payments, with a test report.

faq: Stripe, RevenueCat, Firebase, OneSignal, Mixpanel, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Sentry and any service with a public API are common. If yours is unusual, send the API docs and we confirm the fit first.
Who pays for the connected services?
You do, directly to each provider. Our price covers only the work of connecting and testing them. Many providers have free tiers, and we point out any costs before we start.
Will in-app purchases follow store rules?
Yes. Apple and Google require their own billing for digital goods in most cases. We build with their rules in mind and tell you early if a plan needs a different approach.
Do you need my API keys or passwords?
We never ask for passwords. Add us as a team member in each tool, or send test keys through a secure channel. Live keys stay in your own environment settings, not in the code.
